plan.title: SRC-AWD-006 — Award L1 vendor and approve proposal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90 for 10 units.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case configuration.
Verify both bidding vendors are present with real names.
Verify the Master QCS arithmetic for Vendor B, including 90 × 10 = 900.
Verify the lower total ranks first, making Vendor B the L1 vendor.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 units on the line to the second vendor, Vendor B.
Verify one of two vendors is selected and the proposal total is 900.
Create and submit the award proposal for the L1 vendor using the prepared allocation.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Verify the submitted proposal is awaiting approval before the approver acts.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal from Approvals, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as a separate approver, so this is the required human step.
After approval, complete PO creation and read back the resulting purchase order.
Verify one PO carries the awarded line with quantity 10.
Open the History tab where the approved closed event should appear.
Verify the History events list rendered without an error.
Verify the awarded event is represented as closed in History.
